uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3249-4976--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-4976--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4316-4871-5220-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4316-4871-5220-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
4316-4871-5220-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7338.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7338.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

277-1479-5700-5701-7893.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-5700-5701-7893.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

250-779-1479-4693-7893.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-7893.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-4693-7893.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2685-3197-6996-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3197-6996-7810.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2185-5231-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7379.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-814-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-814-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-5315-7189.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability
Repeat.

582-1409-5184.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1144-2645-4178-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

877-1374-5910-7056.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Stormscape Familiar and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

2919-3490-5231-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-5231-6823.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that share a creature type.
74-617-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting White Lotus Tile.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

2942-3011-6899.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
2942-3011-6899.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to 1.5 times their life total, and dealing no damage to you due to With Great Power....

101-1462-6801.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
101-1462-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1462-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

1358-2034-2073-4055--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the mana value 1 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing the artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

136-2593-4067-6281.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Cadaver Imp.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Cadaver Imp that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Cadaver Imp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3951-4452-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
1270-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating three tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-4659-5003-6644.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ancient Adamantoise enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2468-2631.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Alrund's Epiphany without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Alrund's Epiphany, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

141-4050-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

710-1258-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3617-5913-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Pinnacle Monk from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1308-4214-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1308-4214-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1142-2034-2620-4350.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Safehold Elite if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Butcher Ghoul otherwise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazav, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazav dies, if it was a copy of Safehold Elite, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

628-2438-5523.notablePrerequisites: Defiant Greatmaw does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2438-5523.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1071-3158-5095-5109.notablePrerequisites: Rhox Faithmender phased out by Out of Time.
1071-3158-5095-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Volcano Hellion.
Instead of you losing the game as a state-based action, Lich's Mirror causes you to shuffle your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library, causing Rhox Faithmender to return to the battlefield as Out of Time leaves the battlefield, and causing you to gain life equal to twice the amount of damage dealt to you plus 40.

2619-4483-5116.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
2619-4483-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Rod of Absorption.
Echo Storm triggers, copying itself for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Gilded Lotus.
Resolve all copies of Echo Storm, creating that many token copies of Gilded Lotus.
Resolve the original Echo Storm, creating a token copy of Rod of Absorption and exiling Echo Storm due to Rod of Absorption.
Activate two Gilded Lotus tokens by tapping them, adding six mana of any color.
Activate the original Rod of Absorption by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to cast Echo Storm from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting the Rod of Absorption token.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact you control using Echo Storm.

435-1355-3953-4618.notablePrerequisites:
Instill Energy attached to Sanctum Weaver.
You have not used Instill Energy's ability this turn.
435-1355-3953-4618.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Auratog by sacrificing Instill Energy.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling Instill Energy from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Auratog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Cast Instill Energy from exile by paying {G}, attaching it to Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

291-1283-4050-4853.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Myr Matrix by paying {5}, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {1}.
The Myr dies, triggering Dross Scorpion, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, if you control a colored permanent, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead to draw infinite cards.

1734-2034-3913.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, exiling Crypt Champion.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding {C}{C}.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, returning Crypt Champion from exile to the battlefield.
Crypt Champion enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Crypt Champion trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1168-1479-3478.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1168-1479-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Toggo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Toggo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
